text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Testing also gives developers confidence. When they make changes, they can run the tests and see immediately if something has broken. Without good testing, even small updates can cause serious problems.
